svg.title: Three Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions; subtitle: Base uses 1 FT + 2 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time; C means contractor. Each numeric value represents one person in the five-person scaled design. Only the first three seats operate in Conservative and Base cases. Contractor hours are not assumed equivalent to full-time hours.; caption: The owner controls exposure; operators maintain evidence and reconciliation. Adding people does not automatically produce the Scaled scenario's $360,000 owner profit.; stages: label: Owner and capital lead; value: Core full-time seat across all scenarios; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own counterparty selection, issuer relationships, cash coverage and concentration limits. Authorize purchases against documented commitments rather than available card limits alone.; label: Settlement and ledger specialist; value: Core contractor seat for daily reconciliations; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the 60-day statement horizon, reconcile buying-group ACH and exchange payouts, track rebates and flag receivables that pass contractual due dates.; label: Inventory and fulfillment coordinator; value: Core contractor seat for delivery and listings; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track insured shipments, serial numbers and ticket transfers. Use SkyBox or Automatiq to reconcile exchange inventory and apply owner-defined markdown curves.; label: Allocation and operations manager; value: Additional full-time seat in the Scaled case; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Manage a larger authorized allocation pipeline and buying-group order book. Separate commercial sourcing from settlement reconciliation while preserving one exposure ledger.; label: Exception and peak-event specialist; value: Additional contractor seat in the Scaled case; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Resolve transfer failures, carrier claims, disputed reimbursements and event-week listing exceptions. Maintain evidence trails without overriding purchasing or issuer restrictions.

text.title: Three Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions
text.tspan: Three Core Seats, Two Explicit Scale Additions

rect.title: label: Owner and capital lead; value: Core full-time seat across all scenarios; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own counterparty selection, issuer relationships, cash coverage and concentration limits. Authorize purchases against documented commitments rather than available card limits alone.

text.title: Own counterparty selection, issuer relationships, cash coverage and concentration limits. Authorize purchases against documented commitments rather than available card limits alone.

rect.title: label: Settlement and ledger specialist; value: Core contractor seat for daily reconciliations; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain the 60-day statement horizon, reconcile buying-group ACH and exchange payouts, track rebates and flag receivables that pass contractual due dates.

text.title: Maintain the 60-day statement horizon, reconcile buying-group ACH and exchange payouts, track rebates and flag receivables that pass contractual due dates.

rect.title: label: Inventory and fulfillment coordinator; value: Core contractor seat for delivery and listings; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Track insured shipments, serial numbers and ticket transfers. Use SkyBox or Automatiq to reconcile exchange inventory and apply owner-defined markdown curves.

text.title: Track insured shipments, serial numbers and ticket transfers. Use SkyBox or Automatiq to reconcile exchange inventory and apply owner-defined markdown curves.

rect.title: label: Allocation and operations manager; value: Additional full-time seat in the Scaled case; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Manage a larger authorized allocation pipeline and buying-group order book. Separate commercial sourcing from settlement reconciliation while preserving one exposure ledger.

text.title: Manage a larger authorized allocation pipeline and buying-group order book. Separate commercial sourcing from settlement reconciliation while preserving one exposure ledger.

rect.title: label: Exception and peak-event specialist; value: Additional contractor seat in the Scaled case; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Resolve transfer failures, carrier claims, disputed reimbursements and event-week listing exceptions. Maintain evidence trails without overriding purchasing or issuer restrictions.

text.title: Resolve transfer failures, carrier claims, disputed reimbursements and event-week listing exceptions. Maintain evidence trails without overriding purchasing or issuer restrictions.

Assumptions: FT means full-time; C means contractor. Each numeric value represents one person in the five-person scaled design. Only the first three seats operate in Conservative and Base cases. Contractor hours are not assumed equivalent to full-time hours.
